description: Fixture cases for PCF-WI-PROFILE-TASK-PROGRESS-POLLING-ENFORCEMENT-MINIMUM verifier. Cases A-J cover no-poll enforcement for running task status queries.

case_a_terminal_status_no_retrieval_reas.description: Terminal (done) task queried without retrieval_reason must succeed normally.

case_b_draft_status_no_retrieval_reason_.description: Draft task queried without retrieval_reason must succeed normally.

case_c_running_missing_retrieval_reason_.description: Running task queried without retrieval_reason must be rejected with normal_path_progress_poll_forbidden.

case_d_running_with_valid_retrieval_reas.description: Running task queried with valid retrieval_reason must not be rejected by the missing-reason guard.

case_e_running_with_invalid_retrieval_re.description: Running task queried with invalid retrieval_reason value must be rejected with invalid_retrieval_reason error.

case_f_running_repeated_poll_rejected.description: Running task queried twice within min interval with valid retrieval_reason must be rejected with repeated_progress_poll_forbidden on the second query.

case_g_terminal_with_retrieval_reason_st.description: Terminal task queried WITH retrieval_reason must still succeed (retrieval_reason is optional, not forbidden, for terminal tasks).

case_h_not_found_task_no_retrieval_reaso.description: Non-existent task queried without retrieval_reason returns not_found (no poll guard needed).

case_i_all_retrieval_reasons_valid.description: All six retrieval_reason values must be accepted by the validator.

case_j_schema_has_retrieval_reason_param.description: The SCHEMA must declare retrieval_reason as an optional parameter in the properties.
